name: petrified wood
enchant_note: Wood turned to stone: whatever magic it had is long dead.
protection_note: A shield's petrified wood: held, not worn, so it guards with its AC alone.
lore_descriptor: wood turned to stone, with mineral veins where the grain used to be
first_pickup_chronicle: Petrified wood armor, heavy as a boulder. Fire does it little harm.
design_notes: Fills peak_floor 12 gap. Dense rare wood that resists fire. Mundane (max_enchant 1) — its weight is its magic.
